name: @niivue/nv-ext-tile
description: Tiled and chunked image formats for NiiVue: pyramidal TIFF/OME-TIFF/SVS by HTTP Range (/tiff), DICOM-WSI folders and hosted manifests (/dicom), and OME-Zarr volumes (/zarr)
comment:niivue-peer: workspace:^, not workspace:* (which bun publish pins to the exact rc): published as ^<core version at publish>, so one release accepts later niivue rcs and 1.x, and the floor never predates an API this package uses.

scripts.build: bunx --bun vite build && bunx --bun vite build -c vite.config.standalone.ts && bun scripts/check-standalone.ts
